question: Can H/M/C/I source regimes be defined feasibly and distinctly on matched training exposures at native weights 100 and 500?

forward.encoder_precision: normal C CUDA bf16 autocast forward
forward.rng: restore seed native checkpoint100 RNG inside every batch audit; identical across weights; restore caller afterward

scoring.input: detach forward image/text features, cast float32, then L2 renormalize
scoring.precision_flags_scope: selection and candidate-audit computations only; preserve original flags around the historical encoder forward/preparation
scoring.similarity: Q @ V.T; float32 cosine; no clamping
scoring.exclude: paired image index only; no species filtering
scoring.ties: ascending batch index after primary score key; stable sorting

ideal_fp32.mixture: mean of selected V rows then normalize in FP32
ideal_fp32.similarity: dot FP32 unit query with unit candidate

reference_mixed.support: identical frozen FP32-selected IDs; no reselection
reference_mixed.weights: support cast to original raw_similarity dtype divided by its row sum, detached; then cast to original image feature dtype
reference_mixed.mixture: weights @ original image_features under CUDA bf16 autocast, then torch.nn.functional.normalize(dim=-1, eps=1e-12)
reference_mixed.training_score: (original text_features * generated_candidate).sum(-1) inside same autocast; positive from original raw_similarity diagonal
reference_mixed.selection_score: renormalize generated candidate in FP32 and dot FP32-renormalized query, relative to FP32 positive
reference_mixed.select_reference: original raw_similarity entry at selected index; also record FP32 selection margin
reference_mixed.scope: candidate reference path only; this does not freeze D1 arms, outcomes, pressure or estimand

validity.insufficient_support: undefined support and candidates, availability recorded; continue D0
validity.invalid_mixture: retain source support and source statistics; null affected synthetic fields with reason; flag construction numerical infeasibility; continue D0
validity.invalid_forward_or_score: save failure and stop audit; no silent omission
validity.I_invariant: if FP32 positive cosine >= 0 and ideal mixture valid: r_ideal_synth <= r_ideal_select + 1e-5 and r_ideal_select <= 1e-5
validity.invariant_failure: save record and stop; no automatic retry or tolerance adjustment
validity.mixed_precision_disagreement: record separately; ideal invariant is not enforced across different scoring/normalization paths
other_invariants: H/C overlap=k minus number of nonpositive H contributors when C feasible
validity.missing_statistics: null with denominator and reason, never zero; missing mixture does not erase valid source overlap

fields: 63 candidate source IDs and species IDs
all63 FP32 margins and original-forward margins
ordered support IDs and canonical support hashes
absolute synthetic margin minus absolute real margin
all six pairwise support overlaps and support equality
historical H/M k8 overlap and exact-set agreement
measurements.small_margin_threshold_role: descriptive coverage only; no selection filter, utility proxy or k optimization
measurements.histogram_rule: left-inclusive/right-exclusive except final bin includes upper edge; explicit underflow, overflow, exact-zero and missing counts
measurements.support_hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON (sorted keys, separators comma/colon, no NaN) of ordered batch indices and corresponding source indices; set equality computed separately from ordered hash

analysis.unit: query exposure, not unique image or independent replicate
analysis.primary_feasibility: all k curves, N_nonpositive=0, and joint C/I eligibility at both weights on initial batches
analysis.extended_feasibility: same summaries across all50 fixed-model batches; primary is a subset, never add sample counts
analysis.paired_comparisons: common eligible and numerically valid exposure intersection for compared regimes/paths/states, with denominators and coverage; also report regime-specific populations separately
analysis.conditional_distributions: pooled exposure distributions, explicitly labelled; source-member distributions labelled separately from query-level summaries
analysis.macro_means: streams within seed then equal seeds; per-stream conditional means require nonempty denominator in every required stratum or macro mean is null; pooled alternatives separately labelled
analysis.calibration_means: seeds equally, no artificial duplication by stream
analysis.semantics: same-species association is descriptive, not an identified false-negative label

historical_comparison.rule: apply exact B select_supports(raw_similarity,k=8,start_rank=16) to same forward; compare support sets to new FP32 H/M

design_decisions.all_query_candidate: k>=2; 100% structural support availability for every required C/I query at both states, over extended continuation and separate calibration populations; valid synthesis required on both paths
design_decisions.candidate_sizes: report every passing k; do not automatically select one
design_decisions.k1: feasibility diagnostic only; not a uniform-synthesis-vs-selection contrast
design_decisions.zero_nonpositive: any such intended query rules out all-query in-batch I for every k>=1 on that audited population
design_decisions.eligible_query_design: report within-state and cross-state common coverage; no automatic coverage cutoff or D1 enrollment rule
design_decisions.redundancy: report full overlap/equality curves; exact redundancy requires all common feasible supports equal, nonempty coverage, and same real/synthetic candidate paths; no automatic near-redundancy threshold or arm removal
design_decisions.forbidden: selecting k, arms or populations to maximize apparently helpful margins, expected training utility, reporting outcomes or retrieval
design_decisions.amendment: new version and stated feasibility/separability rationale before new D0 computation if candidate pool/scoring changes; D1 separately frozen after audit, including branch-time infeasibility handling

outputs.query_records: gzip JSONL, one per query exposure; strict JSON null for missing values; no NaN/Infinity
outputs.provenance: issued protocol/plan/freeze/source manifest, state fingerprints, batch/caption identity hashes, environment and state-preservation audits
outputs.completion: separate successful computational audit from treatment feasibility; infeasible support does not itself mean failed D0
